notes.title: 🚨 Get Access to the Quartermaster Playtest! 🚨
notes.content:
[b]Quartermasters, assemble.[/b]
Are you ready to get your hands on a work-in-progress sneak peek of [i]Quartermaster[/i] during our very first public playtest? We’d love to hear what you think of the game in its current state so we can make it even better.
[hr][/hr]
[h3]📝 How to join? Super simple:[/h3]

1. Click the image below (or [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3657070/Quartermaster/]HERE[/url][/b]) to head to the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3657070/Quartermaster/]Quartermaster Steam Store Page[/url][/b].

2. Scroll down and click the “[b]Request Access[/b]” button.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3657070/Quartermaster/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703722/d99ed3ec6619fbbfea86a20542d5401489bb7550.png[/img][/url]

That’s it!

Everyone selected will be notified once access is granted. We will announce the exact date of the playtest soon!
During the playtest, you’ll have access to a special version of the game. We'll also ask you to fill out a short survey about your experience — it’ll only take a few minutes, and it helps us a lot.
We can’t wait to hear what you think!

[b]Important Note:[/b]
This is a [b]work-in-progress[/b] version of the game. It’s not final, and it’s far from complete. Expect bugs, crashes, and a few rough edges. That’s part of the journey, and your feedback will help us shape what comes next.

[b]To stay in the loop on all things Quartermaster, follow us here:[/b]
[b][url=https://discord.gg/uC44H7KwnK]Discord[/url][/b]
[b][url=https://www.facebook.com/cherrypickgames]Facebook[/url][/b]
[b][url=https://x.com/cherrypickgames]X (formerly Twitter)[/url][/b]


And if you haven’t already, please [b]wishlist and follow Quartermaster[/b] on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3657070/Quartermaster/

[i]This message will self-destruct in 5, 4, 3, 2…[/i] 😉

notes.title: 🔥 The very first anno!
notes.content:
[h3][b]🌍 Hello World![/b][/h3][p]We’re super excited to welcome everyone to the very first instalment of the Quartermaster devlog![/p][p]To kick things off, we’d like to take this opportunity to introduce ourselves and share how Quartermaster came to life.[/p][p]We are Cherrypick Games, a boutique independent game developer with quite a track record.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703722/70cde46977028194ad0648589465882d046c4f28.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]📜 A bit of history[/b][/h3][p]The studio was founded back in 2014, when two colleagues, who were working at one of the biggest PC and console game developers in Poland, decided to join forces and establish their studio. At the time, the focus was on mobile-first titles.[/p][p]We started with a series of casual mobile games, but our initial ambition was to create a mobile simulation-building game: My Hospital. The game was a success, and it was just the beginning.[/p][p]We continued developing and self-publishing increasingly ambitious mobile games until we decided it was time to shift our focus to PC. This pivot felt natural as our roots were in PC development, and we were already deeply excited about the thriving indie scene on platforms like Steam. So, we took a leap of faith and began the transformation.
[/p][h3][b]🚪 Enter Quartermaster[/b][/h3][p]That was then, this is now.[/p][p]Quartermaster began as a passion project in mid-2024. When the idea to combine base-building with spies, gadgets, and undercover operations first surfaced, we were all in. Partnering with the amazing crew at Frozen District has made the thought of engaging on the journey even more exciting![/p][p]We’re currently a tight-knit team of ten people, all focused on what we affectionately call Q. We’re united by our love of games, pop culture, and, of course, game development. Our motto is quality first, and we’re pouring our hearts into making Quartermaster something truly special.[/p][p]That’s it for a quick introduction to who we are.
[/p][h3][b]⌛ Coming up[/b][/h3][p]In the upcoming devlog entries, we’ll be diving deeper into the game itself.[/p][p]We’ll shed more light on the mechanics and lore, reveal some unique features currently in development, and share behind-the-scenes stories straight from the production team. So make sure to stay tuned![/p][p]
Till then,
Mike and the Cherrypick Games Team🍒[/p][hr][/hr][p]P.S. Want to stay in the loop on all things Quartermaster? Join us on:[/p][list][*][p]Discord ([url="https://discord.gg/uC44H7KwnK"]LINK[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Facebook ([url="https://www.facebook.com/cherrypickgames"]LINK[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]X (formerly Twitter) ([url="https://x.com/cherrypickgames"]LINK[/url])[/p][/*][/list][p]And don’t forget to wishlist and follow Quartermaster if you haven’t already.[/p][p]…And to all the spy fans out there: This message will self-destruct in 5, 4, 3, 2… 😉
[/p]
